recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-paneled graphic composition combining high-contrast photography of DJ equipment with cybernetic 3D wireframe humanoids and a rigid geometric grid system. The style is heavily influenced by late 90s/early 2000s 'Y2K' futurism, utilizing bright primary colors against dark tech-inspired backgrounds.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical yellow bar on the left containing a tilted turntable photograph.
Central square frame featuring a glowing green wireframe torso with target overlays.
Horizontal red band at the bottom third for primary display typography.
Repetitive silhouette pattern along the top edge.
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white photography for mechanical elements.
Green digital grid background behind the central figure.
Strict rectangular framing for all sub-elements.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central cybernetic figure is the primary focal point, scaled to fill the middle square. The turntable on the left acts as a secondary vertical anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold red horizontal text bar near the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central green figure, move left to the vertical turntable, then drop to the red text bar and final metadata at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with textures, grids, and overlapping panels.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Yellow and Black provide the structural foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Red acts as a separator and typographic background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon Green for the digital/cybernetic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the primary colors (red/yellow) contrasted with high-value neon green against a dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses ultra-bold, wide, square-proportioned glyphs with rounded outer corners.
Secondary text uses a stylized, lowercase-heavy techno font with uniform stroke weights.
Tertiary text uses a condensed, blocky sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tightly tracked to create a solid block of color.
The 'E' and 'A' characters in the main title have horizontal bars that align perfectly across the word.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking contrasting widths: wide display text over condensed metadata text.
graphicDevices: Brushed metal texture for metadata plates

preserve: Square proportions of the display font

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric Y2K aesthetic.
Provides the necessary square-off techno feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage with a vertical yellow bar on the left containing a B&W photo of a turntable. The center should be a black square with a green digital grid and a 3D wireframe human torso. Add a red horizontal bar across the bottom third and a row of black silhouettes at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply wide, yellow geometric techno-display text inside the red bar. Add smaller white stylized text below it. Place a brushed metal rectangular plate at the bottom right with condensed black sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the main text wide and geometric?
Are the turntable photos high-contrast B&W?
Does the red bar span the full width?

adjustableVariables: Color of the grid (cyan vs green)
Subject of the wireframe (head vs torso)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is illegible due to background noise.
Verify the yellow, red, and green do not clash vibratingly.
Check that the wireframe looks like a 3D model, not a flat drawing.
Confirm the turntable is recognizable as mechanical equipment.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Mechanical B&W Photo] + [Neon Digital Grid] + [3D Wireframe Subject] + [Bold Geometric Color Blocking] + [Wide Techno Typography].
